record.question: The difference between capital and revenue expenditure is best described by.
options: Capital expenditure relates only to salaries, while revenue expenditure relates only to infrastructure
Capital expenditure creates assets, whereas revenue expenditure is incurred for the normal running of government departments and maintenance of existing assets
Revenue expenditure is always larger than capital expenditure
Capital expenditure includes all expenditure booked to the Consolidated Fund, while revenue expenditure is charged only to the Contingency Fund
